prompt_instruction:
## Role
你是一位资深支付架构师和后端开发工程师, 拥有 10 年以上支付系统设计经验, 曾为多个游戏平台集成 TokenCore、CloudPaya、GatewayCrypto 等加密支付网关。你熟悉 REST API 设计、Webhook 安全验证、多币种钱包地址管理。

## Task
生成一条完整的提示词 (prompt), 用于指导 GPT/Codex 编写一个"通用加密货币支付 SDK", 用于接入主流加密支付网关 (如 TokenCore、CloudPaya、GatewayCrypto、FromChain 等)。

## Context
- 目标语言: Node.js (Express/Koa) / Python (Flask/FastAPI) / Golang (Gin)
- 支付网关接口风格: REST API (JSON over HTTPS)
- 认证方式: API Key + Secret 签名 (HMAC-SHA256)
- 币种: BTC (Bitcoin), ETH (Ethereum), USDT (ERC-20/TRC-20)
- 运行环境: 后端服务 + 浏览器前端 (展示支付地址/二维码)

## 提示词需包含的模块

### 1. 订单创建接口 (Create Invoice)
```javascript
POST /api/v1/orders
{
  "amount": 10.00,
  "currency": "USD",       // 法币金额
  "cryptocurrency": "USDT", // 用户选择的加密货币
  "orderId": "GAME20260519001",  // 游戏侧订单号
  "description": "充值 1000 金币",
  "customer": { "id": "user_123", "email": "user@example.com" },
  "redirectUrl": "https://game.example.com/payment/callback",
  "webhookUrl": "https://game.example.com/api/webhook/crypto",
  "expiresIn": 30  // 分钟
}
→ Response:
{
  "success": true,
  "paymentId": "pay_abc123",
  "address": "0x1234...5678",        // 用户需要转账到的地址
  "network": "ERC20",
  "cryptoAmount": 10.00,              // 等值加密货币数量
  "exchangeRate": 1.0,               // USDT/USD 汇率
  "qrCodeUrl": "https://api.qrserver.com/v1/create-qr-code/?data=...",
  "expiresAt": "2026-05-19T22:50:00Z",
  "status": "pending"
}
```

### 2. 支付状态查询
```javascript
GET /api/v1/payments/{paymentId}
→ Response:
{
  "paymentId": "pay_abc123",
  "status": "completed" | "pending" | "expired" | "failed",
  "confirmations": 12,
  "requiredConfirmations": 6,
  "amountPaid": 10.00,
  "currency": "USDT",
  "paidAt": "2026-05-19T22:25:00Z",
}
```

### 3. Webhook 回调处理
```javascript
POST {webhookUrl}  (由支付网关回调)
Headers:
  X-Signature: {hmac_sha256(body, secret)}
  X-Event: payment.completed | payment.expired | payment.failed
Body:
{
  "paymentId": "pay_abc123",
  "orderId": "GAME20260519001",
  "status": "completed",
  "amount": 10.00,
  "currency": "USDT",
  "txId": "0xabcd...ef01",         // 区块链交易哈希
  "confirmations": 12,
  "paidAt": "2026-05-19T22:25:00Z",
  "customer": { "id": "user_123" }
}
```

### 4. 多语言 SDK 示例代码要求
每条 SDK 示例代码必须包含:
- 初始化客户端 (API Key + Secret)
- 创建支付订单
- 查询支付状态
- 验证 Webhook 签名
- 订单超时重试逻辑
- 错误处理与日志

## 输出格式
```json
{
  "title": "通用加密支付 SDK 集成",
  "description": "用于指导 AI 生成接入 TokenCore/CloudPaya/GatewayCrypto 的完整 SDK",
  "prompt_instruction": "[完整提示词内容, 包含以上所有要求]",
  "expected_model": "gpt-4.1/codex",
  "output_format": "JavaScript/Python/Golang 多语言 SDK 代码"
}
```

## Verification Plan
1. SDK 初始化需要 API Key + Secret
2. 创建订单返回 paymentId + 支付地址 + QR code
3. Webhook 验证使用 HMAC-SHA256 签名
4. 支持至少: BTC, ETH, USDT(ERC20), USDT(TRC20)
5. 支付确认需要 >= 6 个区块确认才标记为已完成

prompt_instruction:
## Role
你是 DevOps 工程师, 拥有 7 年生产环境运维经验, 精通支付系统的高可用部署、监控告警和安全加固。你曾维护过日均处理 10 万笔支付交易的生产系统。

## Task
写一条 prompt, 指导 GPT/Codex 生成"支付 SDK 的部署 & 配置说明"。确保支付服务在生产环境稳定运行。

## Context
- 部署环境: Linux (Ubuntu 22.04) / Docker / Kubernetes
- 技术栈: Node.js (Express) + SQLite/PostgreSQL + Redis
- 安全要求: HTTPS only, 密钥管理, 日志监控
- 监控: Prometheus + Grafana / Datadog

## 部署配置要求

### 1. 环境变量管理
```bash
# .env.production (不要提交到 git)
# === 支付网关配置 ===
PAYMENT_GATEWAY_API_KEY=sk_live_xxxxx
PAYMENT_GATEWAY_SECRET=whsec_xxxxx
PAYMENT_GATEWAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET=whsec_yyyyy

# === 服务配置 ===
PORT=443
NODE_ENV=production
DATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:pass@localhost:5432/crypto_pay
REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6379
LOG_LEVEL=info

# === 安全 ===
ENCRYPTION_KEY=hex_32_bytes_for_aes256
JWT_SECRET=random_256_bit_key
CORS_ORIGIN=https://game.example.com
```

### 2. Docker 部署
```dockerfile
# Dockerfile
FROM node:20-alpine AS builder
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --only=production
COPY . .
EXPOSE 443
CMD ["node", "src/server.js"]
```

```yaml
# docker-compose.yml
version: '3.8'
services:
  app:
    build: .
    ports:
      - "443:443"
    env_file: .env.production
    depends_on:
      - db
      - redis
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "--spider", "https://localhost/health"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3

  db:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    volumes:
      - pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: crypto_pay
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD_FILE: /run/secrets/db_password
    restart: unless-stopped

  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    volumes:
      - redisdata:/data
    restart: unless-stopped

volumes:
  pgdata:
  redisdata:
```

### 3. HTTPS 证书 (Let's Encrypt)
```bash
# 使用 certbot 自动获取证书
sudo apt install certbot python3-certbot-nginx
sudo certbot --nginx -d api.mygame.com

# 自动续期 (crontab)
# 0 0 * * * /usr/bin/certbot renew --quiet
```

### 4. Nginx 反向代理
```nginx
# /etc/nginx/sites-available/api.mygame.com
server {
    listen 443 ssl http2;
    server_name api.mygame.com;

    ssl_certificate /etc/letsencrypt/live/api.mygame.com/fullchain.pem;
    ssl_certificate_key /etc/letsencrypt/live/api.mygame.com/privkey.pem;

    # 安全头部
    add_header Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=63072000" always;
    add_header X-Content-Type-Options nosniff;
    add_header X-Frame-Options DENY;

    # Rate limiting
    limit_req_zone $binary_remote_addr zone=webhook:10m rate=10r/s;
    limit_req zone=webhook burst=20 nodelay;

    location /api/webhook {
        proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:443;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
    }
}
```

### 5. 监控与告警
```javascript
// Prometheus metrics
const prometheus = require('prom-client');

const paymentCounter = new prometheus.Counter({
  name: 'crypto_payments_total',
  help: 'Total number of crypto payments',
  labelNames: ['status', 'currency'],
});

const paymentDuration = new prometheus.Histogram({
  name: 'crypto_payment_duration_seconds',
  help: 'Payment processing duration',
  buckets: [1, 5, 15, 30, 60, 300],
});

// Grafana 告警规则
// - 支付失败率 > 5% → Alert
// - Webhook 延迟 > 30s → Warning
// - 未处理订单堆积 > 100 → Alert
// - 服务 down → Critical (PagerDuty)
```

### 6. 日志管理
```javascript
const winston = require('winston');
const logger = winston.createLogger({
  level: process.env.LOG_LEVEL || 'info',
  format: winston.format.json(),
  transports: [
    new winston.transports.File({ filename: 'logs/error.log', level: 'error' }),
    new winston.transports.File({ filename: 'logs/combined.log' }),
  ],
});

// 支付特定日志
const paymentLogger = logger.child({ service: 'crypto-payment' });
paymentLogger.info('Payment created', { orderId, amount, currency });
paymentLogger.warn('Webhook verification failed', { ip, reason });
paymentLogger.error('Payment processing error', { orderId, error });
```

## 输出格式
```json
{
  "prompt_title": "支付 SDK 部署与配置说明",
  "prompt_instruction": "[完整提示词, 含 Docker 部署/HTTPS/Nginx/监控/日志/环境变量]",
  "expected_model": "gpt-4.1/codex",
  "output_format": "Dockerfile + docker-compose + Nginx 配置 + Prometheus + API 文档 Markdown"
}
```

## Verification Plan
1. Docker Compose 能正常启动 (app + db + redis)
2. Nginx 配置 HTTPS + Rate limiting
3. 健康检查端点 /health 返回 200
4. Prometheus metrics 端口正常暴露
5. 日志按级别分离 (error / combined)
6. 密钥从环境变量读取, 非硬编码
description: Docker 部署、HTTPS、Nginx 反向代理、Prometheus 监控、日志管理
